checkpoint_and_model_selection: mean first-two-target group-equal validation log loss; exclude exact graph-input overlap with training
vendor_anomaly_selection: training group-weighted prior only; random injection is negative control
standardization: observed values per node/feature fitted on training only; append original masks and node-type indicators
computational_edges: directed source-to-target plus self loops; no reverse edges; shuffle uses fixed node permutation of endpoints only
readout: two single-head additive-attention layers; mean node pooling; three binary logits
scope: single-seed exploratory in-simulator classification, not observed physical adjacency or causal inference
